h_contagion_liq.evidence: 11/210 directed Granger edges significant at Bonferroni-adjusted p < 0.01; final network density 0.0524 >= 2% materiality floor; permutation null rejected for top edges (empirical p = 0). Lead-lag matrix 15x15 x 24 computed. Not dominated by a single coin; ETH->LINK, XRP->CRV, SOL->LINK among top edges.

h_contagion_funding.evidence: Funding-tercile monotonicity 38/112 pairs (rate 0.339) below the 0.5 support threshold; no >=2% relative difference between high- and low-differential terciles established. Funding-mediated spillover not confirmed.

materiality_definition: Contagion effect must explain >= 2% relative variance in target coin liquidations; funding modulation must produce >= 2% relative edge-weight difference between high/low differential terciles. Floor frozen; not relaxed after outcomes.
inference: Bonferroni across 210 directed Granger tests (alpha 4.8e-05); 1000 permutations per pair (210,000 null statistics); funding-tercile conditioning; volatility spillover rv24h(src)->liq_count(tgt); temporal stability rolling 90-day windows 30-day step (17 windows, mean density 0.3445).
